notes.title: 🚗 Update 3.2.0 — new cars, tournaments, and improvements

notes.title: Update 2.7.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147333/e36b352b283c4ec16e0f4b969b3d13777c0301e3.jpg[/img]
🚘 Added cars:
T:Chaser X90 Tourer V and G:3102 to car dealership
D:Challenger III SRT  to the tournament car market
💿 New disks for G:3102
👨‍🌾 Added “Summer Season” skins for G:3102, L:2108, L:2106 cars
👑 Added new liveries for bosses
🧮 Added a drive type (AWD, FWD, RWD) classification in tournaments, but removed the classification by car
♻ Groups in tournaments are now selected not only by rank, but also by car class
📈 Increased drop rate of some swap parts

notes.title: Update 2.6.0
notes.notes:
🏆 Instead of numerous tournaments there will be a single tournament that lasts a week, it is now divided into 6 stages of 24 hours each
🏎 Added new car: F:512 TR 
📰 Added the new top: Stage 2100
🎨 Paint n' Spray was reworked
💡 Changed the conditions for obtaining the last two qualifications in connection with the new tournaments (reduced the required number of getting into the top tournament from 3 to 1 and from 15 to 4)

notes.title: Update 2.5.0
notes.notes:
Hi!
🚘  Added F:Supervan and D:Charger 2gen cars to the showroom, and BMW M3 E46 to the tournament showroom
🏎️  Cars now have the ability to apply skins
🪲  Added new skins for V: Beetle and B: M3 E46
🔧  Now you can upgrade a car without creating intermediate blueprints in the workshop
♻️  Added the ability to roll back the upgrade of a car with blueprints
🆙  Removed the limit of 4000 tournament points
🔦  Improved shadows for the desktop version of the game
🎯  Added FPS setting for the desktop version
